title: Windows Hopper not following Dark Mode

status.label: Clear Window Hopper design candidate
status.detail: The request identifies Window Hopper, the system dark-theme condition, and the mismatched light presentation.

next_action.label: Design theme integration
next_action.reason: The desired system-theme behavior is specific enough for a focused Window Hopper investigation.

actions.label: Design Window Hopper dark-mode support
actions.note: Investigate Window Hopper theme-resource selection and define verification for light, dark, and theme changes. This drafts no upstream mutation.

judgment.rationale: Although automated triage asked which module was involved, the body explicitly identifies Window Hopper and a reproducible system-theme mismatch.
evidence: The issue names Window Hopper as the affected feature.
The reporter says Windows is set to Dark while Window Hopper remains light.
The requested outcome is for Window Hopper to follow the system theme and visually align more closely with Alt+Tab.
judgment.recommended_action: Run a focused design investigation for Window Hopper theme selection and runtime theme-change behavior.
